page.meta_description: Iguanodon, named from English Wealden teeth and later Belgian coal-mine skeletons, was one of the three genera Richard Owen bundled as Dinosauria. Related…
page.content:
Early Cretaceous ornithopod that helped found Dinosauria.

How Iguanodon connects

  • Character: Gideon Mantell — Gideon Mantell named Iguanodon from Wealden teeth.
  • Topic: Ornithischia — Iguanodon is an early-named ornithopod inside Ornithischia.
  • Topic: Dinosauria — Iguanodon was one of the three genera Owen used to define Dinosauria.

What is Iguanodon?

Iguanodon, named from English Wealden teeth and later Belgian coal-mine skeletons, was one of the three genera Richard Owen bundled as Dinosauria.

Key threads lead to Gideon Mantell, Ornithischia and Dinosauria.
